summary: FASE G-1 Amendment Feature Testing - Backend APIs and Frontend UI integration tested. Backend POC already passed 77/77 tests. Current testing focused on API endpoints and UI flows.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend UI is loading correctly. Amendment modal, trail panel, and center view are all functional. All data-testid attributes are present for testing.

action_item_for_main_agent:
Testing completed successfully for basic amendment flows. Backend APIs (20/21 tests passed, 95.2%) and frontend UI are working correctly. The one backend test failure was due to no amendments existing in the system yet (expected). All core user stories need full end-to-end testing with actual amendment creation, approval flows, RBAC testing with different users, and issued document scenarios. Recommend continuing with comprehensive E2E testing for:

1. USER STORY 1b-1c: Complete amendment proposal with preview and submission
2. USER STORY 2: Large amendment requiring approval + dual control testing
3. USER STORY 3: Amendment trail and document relations
4. USER STORY 4: Issued documents -> Credit/Debit notes (verify original unchanged)
5. USER STORY 5: Config settings integration
6. USER STORY 6: Reason labels management (add/edit/deactivate)
7. USER STORY 7: RBAC testing (warehouse, sales, manager roles)
8. USER STORY 10: Honesty machine (disabled discount rejection)
9. Regression testing on existing SO features
